description: Elections Commission - L. G. Mahindadasa of the Nuwara Eliya Municipal Council has vacated his office of member
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Nuwaraeliya Municipal Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and the administration of local government elections, specifically addressing the vacancy of an elected office as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It does not involve central government personnel or structure, nor does it fit any other specialized category better than Elections.
